label.explanation: Migration 0134_add_status_v2 renamed orders.status_v2 in step 1, then failed in step 2 without rolling back (lines 162, 164, 168). The schema is now in a state no code version expects: the column "status_v2" no longer exists (lines 179, 185, 197, 202), so order-service's queries fail (lines 189, 195, 209, 225, 232, 251) and api-gateway returns 500s (lines 180, 184, 193, 201, 206, 213, 220, 224, 227, 240, 246, 253). Migrations ship with releases, so bad_deploy is defensible, but the fault is the half-applied schema change. Finish or revert step 1. Red herrings: line 167 (a config reload that changed nothing); line 83 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out); lines 125, 134 (a deploy of order-consumer, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally).
